text_block_list.text:
Despite not taking the win, Найс Нэйчер
is able to
look back on the Arima Kinen
as a fun experience
where she strived
with all her might to live up to
her fans'
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then tries to ask Мэдзиро МакКуин
and Mejiro
Ryan for the secret to
becoming even stronger
than she is now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two, pleased by the question,
promise to
answer this question properly
at a later date.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Showing signs of new growth, Nice
Nature aims
for her next goal—the
Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
